mapper.sql: c.id, c.complaint_type complaintType, c.product_id productId, c.order_id orderId, c.complainant_user_id complainantUserId, c.respondent_user_id respondentUserId, c.complaint_reason complaintReason, c.content, c.images, c.handle_status handleStatus, c.handle_result handleResult, c.handle_note handleNote, c.create_time createTime, c.update_time updateTime, p.title productTitle, o.order_no orderNo, cu.nickname complainantNickname, ru.nickname respondentNickname

from complaint c left join product p on c.product_id = p.id left join trade_order o on c.order_id = o.id left join user cu on c.complainant_user_id = cu.id left join user ru on c.respondent_user_id = ru.id
mapper.select:
select
where c.complainant_user_id = #{complainantUserId} order by c.id desc limit 100
